pages.page_goal: Establish image-first as the primary visual delivery path for publishing scenarios.
pages.key_message: Prompts are assets; images are the visible result.
pages.speaker_notes: This sample uses repository placeholder PNGs so UAT can run without consuming API quota.
pages.visual_direction: dark editorial cover image with oversized serif type and warm accent block

pages.page_goal: Explain the difference between image-first and HTML-first delivery.
pages.key_message: The deck can ship as ordered PNGs even before HTML becomes the main surface.

on_slide_text.headline: What image-first proves
body: Images: slide-NN.png is the primary artifact
Prompts: every image keeps an editable prompt file
Manifest: each page has backend and status metadata
on_slide_text.caption: P02 / image-first scope

pages.speaker_notes: Use this page to explain that image-first still preserves prompts and manifests for later regeneration.
pages.visual_direction: editorial two-column explainer image with image files and prompt archive motifs

pages.page_goal: Show that the image-first sample marks most pages as image-needed.
pages.key_message: For image-first, the default assumption is that pages should become raster slides.

on_slide_text.headline: Most pages ask for images
on_slide_text.sub_headline: At least four pages in this sample have needed=true.
on_slide_text.caption: P03 / big idea

pages.speaker_notes: This page is also image-needed, making the path explicit in the slide_plan.
pages.visual_direction: large editorial statement image with paper texture and image manifest pattern

pages.page_goal: Show that prompts and manifest are part of the image-first delivery.
pages.key_message: An image-first deck is reusable when prompts, images, and manifest stay aligned.

on_slide_text.headline: Prompt archive contract
body: Prompt: one markdown file per page
Image: one raster output per page
on_slide_text.caption: P04 / prompt archive

pages.speaker_notes: This page maps to the required prompts/ and images_manifest.json files in the sample.
pages.visual_direction: three editorial modules showing prompt, image, manifest as linked assets

pages.page_title: Run one page before the whole deck
pages.page_goal: Close with the safe real-backend smoke path.
pages.key_message: For real APIs, test --only P01 before spending a full deck budget.

on_slide_text.headline: Run one page before the whole deck
body: Dry-run: inspect manifest and target paths
Full run: expect roughly 60-90 seconds per page
on_slide_text.caption: P05 / close

pages.speaker_notes: Close by reminding UAT testers not to submit full production batches before a single-page smoke passes.
pages.visual_direction: closing editorial image with checklist and timing note
